fluff.overview: The Clan Medium Battle Armor is a Clan-technology medium-weight suit developed by Clan Nova Cat’s Scientist Caste after the Clan’s relocation to the Inner Sphere. Designed as an improvement over the standard Elemental, the suit incorporates enhanced jump mobility at the cost of reduced protection, filling a gap for a more agile powered infantry platform. Its distinctive samurai-influenced styling reflects the Clan’s growing cultural ties to its Draconis Combine hosts. The design’s adaptable chassis proved attractive to multiple Clans, each fielding specialized configurations suited to their own tactical doctrines and operational needs.
fluff.capabilities:
The Bär is purpose-built for WarShip boarding actions and space operations. It replaces the standard missile pack entirely with extended life support systems, allowing troopers to operate for prolonged periods in vacuum or hostile atmospheric conditions. The heavy flamer gives way to a micro pulse laser, better suited to the confined corridors and compartments of naval vessels where area-effect weapons pose risks to ship systems and friendly forces.

A vibro battle claw in the left hand serves as the suit’s primary close-combat weapon, capable of breaching bulkheads and forcing open exterior hatches. The Bär sacrifices the ranged punch of its ground-based counterparts for sustained operational endurance in zero-gravity environments. It retains the base chassis’s HarJel protection and searchlight, both valuable during extended shipboard operations where hull integrity and visibility are constant concerns.
fluff.deployment: Inner Sphere naval infantry forces that obtained the Bär deployed it in four-trooper squads for shipboard security and boarding operations. The suit’s space-optimized design made it valuable for any naval formation, and four-trooper squads could be distributed across smaller vessels where a full Clan Point would strain available berth space.
fluff.history:
Following Clan Nova Cat’s Abjuration from the Clan Homeworlds, the Clan found itself in desperate need of replacement equipment lost during the forced relocation to the Inner Sphere. Khan Santin West, himself an Elemental, took particular interest in rebuilding his battle armor forces. With newer designs emerging from Clan space and the Inner Sphere alike, West charged his Scientist Caste with developing a suit that could hold its own against them.

Working from the basic Elemental chassis, Nova Cat scientists drew inspiration from the Gray Death Legion’s Scout battle armor to dramatically enhance the suit’s mobility. The resulting design emphasized agility over raw protection, with reworked armament to complement its enhanced movement capabilities. The Draconis Combine provided the Nova Cats with new homeworlds and subsidized construction of a dedicated production facility on Irece, strengthening the partnership between the Clan and its hosts.

Development suffered a setback in 3062 when hostilities erupted between Clan Ghost Bear and House Kurita, drawing Nova Cat resources away from the project. The few operational prototypes performed well against Ghost Bear forces, and full-scale production began in 3067. Cat Elementals quickly nicknamed the new suit the “Rabid,” and it soon replaced the standard Elemental as the primary battle armor throughout the Nova Cat Touman. Only senior Elemental commanders retained the older suit to reduce equipment losses.

Clan Diamond Shark, by then established on several Inner Sphere worlds, recognized commercial opportunity in the design. Offering discounted weapons and supplies in exchange for blueprints and schematics, Shark merchants established production lines on Twycross, Trondheim, and Itabaiana. They traded the suit to Clan Ghost Bear and Clan Wolf, both of whom developed specialized configurations tailored to their respective doctrines. Reports that the design was also being marketed to Inner Sphere buyers and Clan Wolf (In Exile) allegedly sparked a confrontation between the Sharks and the Clan Council that escalated near Strana Mechty. Despite this controversy, production continued to expand, with additional manufacturing facilities coming online in subsequent years to meet growing demand across multiple Clans.
